# seg would carry. Rows marked (take N) are the user's own takes from the take log (2026-11-08).
# family  the check that counts the row (PCHECK cases <family>)
# prev    "-": the take's first sentence; "+": a later sentence after a finished one ("Done."); else the take's previous WRITTEN sentence
# raw     what the recogniser wrote, fillers and all; " || " marks a pause the policy held open (the words before it are its mark)
# want    what is written; for family "hold": hold | close (does a pause after `raw` keep the sentence open?)
# rules   the rule names the seg carries, in order, comma-separated; "-" none
